text.hi: आज की कहानी: ‘A Letter to Dadi’ (दादी को चिट्ठी)। पहले कुछ शब्द सीखते हैं।
text.hinglish: Aaj ki kahani: ‘A Letter to Dadi’ (Dadi ko chitthi). Pehle kuch shabd seekhte hain.
text.en: Today's story: ‘A Letter to Dadi’. First, a few words.

text.hi: ‘letter’ मतलब चिट्ठी। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘letter’ matlab chitthi. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘letter’ means चिट्ठी. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘prize’ मतलब इनाम। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘prize’ matlab inaam. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘prize’ means इनाम. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘nervous’ मतलब घबराया हुआ। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘nervous’ matlab ghabraya hua. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘nervous’ means घबराया हुआ. Tap to listen, then say it.

sentences: Dear Dadi, I hope you are well.
I am writing this letter to tell you about my school.
I am in Class Four now.
My new teacher is Mrs Sharma.
She teaches us English with songs.
Last week I won a prize for reading.
I read a story in front of the whole school!
I was nervous, but I did it.
I will show you the prize when I come in the holidays.

question.hi: अर्जुन को इनाम किस लिए मिला?
question.hinglish: Arjun ko inaam kis liye mila?
question.en: What did Arjun win a prize for?

question.hi: अर्जुन की नई टीचर कौन हैं?
question.hinglish: Arjun ki nayi teacher kaun hain?
